[1] Northern Lights was an American Progressive bluegrass band formed in 1975 in New England, which musical career spanned more than three decades.
[2] This influence is evident on tracks such as "Comin' Round" which sampled its chorus from a track by the bluegrass group Yonder Mountain String Band, leadout single "Jimmy Mathis" which is led by a catchy harmonica tune from the Area Code 615 track "Stone Fox Chase", and "She Tried" led by a washboard rhythm section and a mellow fiddle sound.
[3] The Yonder Mountain String Band (abbreviated "YMSB" and referred to by some as just "Yonder") is an American progressive bluegrass group from Nederland, Colorado.
